column1: # Test moves: pure moves of tests between packages or modules.
# Format: old_prefix<TAB>new_prefix, one rule per line. # comments and blank
# lines are ignored. scripts/android/test_inventory.sh --diff renames every
# baseline line "<section>:<rest>" whose <rest> starts with an old prefix
# (longest prefix wins) before comparing it with the current inventory.
# Only pure moves belong here: the test body and its name stay the same, only
# its package, target or module path changes. A new, renamed-in-substance or
# deleted test is never a rule. A rule that matches no baseline line (stale)
# or two baseline lines mapped to one name (collision) fail the check.
# Each block starts with a comment naming the card that moved the tests.
